source.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original standalone Theandril strategic pixel-art sprite, not a sheet or concept scene. Genuine transparent PNG background, alpha zero outside the isolated subject, no painted checkerboard and no ambient haze. Entire subject and every tip, boot, wheel, rope or roof enclosed in central 65% of a square canvas with generous transparent padding. Weathered serious medieval dark fantasy, adult practical proportions, no cute/chibi anatomy. Crisp square pixel clusters, strong grouped midtones and restrained material highlights, detail intended for a small native sprite rather than a smooth painting. Soft upper-left light, selective dark local-color outlines. Shallow front-right southeast strategic view, figures and hulls face screen RIGHT/lower right. No text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, copied heraldry, neon, glow, floor tile, pedestal, background scenery, cast shadow plane, smooth gradient or isolated noise. Culture: Manytrack Moot. Bark black, pale tawny hide, moss blue, stitched raw linen. Crossed path cords, broad clearance arch motifs and wood/hide shields. Open gathering rings, broad low communal halls, varied-height doors and maintained route gates; not an untamed beastcamp. Original heraldry: A fork joining three unlike broad tracks. A maintained practical culture of several humanoid lineages and human households; not a feral beast camp. Native64. ONE front-facing culture crest only, broad exact original heraldic motif in a restrained worn material frame. Simple readable geometry and large negative spaces, no letters or extra marks. Front-facing UI view overrides world camera. No character, collage, banner pole or background plaque reaching image edges.

replacement.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original standalone raster pixel-art culture crest for Theandril, ui.crest.manytrack_moot version2. Create a genuinely transparent PNG with alpha zero outside the emblem: no painted checkerboard, background, ground plane, ambient haze, glow or shadow. Primary subject: ONLY a bold three-way fork joining THREE UNLIKE BROAD FOOT/ROAD TRACKS. Exactly three broad arms meet at one clear central junction, like a simple upright Y-shaped crossing viewed straight-on; no enclosing frame. One arm is moss-blue and has a few broad squared tread notches, one is tawny and has a few broad rounded footstep/tread impressions, and one is raw-linen cream with two wide parallel route grooves. Their different broad edge/tread shapes remain legible as three different kinds of travelled track joining peacefully. These are a heraldic mark, NOT actual scenery or a map, NOT flowing water. Keep each arm simple and substantial, with large clean transparent wedges between arms. Serious weathered medieval fantasy pixel art, restrained bark-dark edge accents and tiny grouped worn highlights only, crisp square pixel clusters designed to remain clear after fitting to a 64x64 native canvas. Front-facing flat emblem, balanced centered silhouette fully inside the central 60% of a square canvas, generous genuine transparent margins on every side. Colors limited visually to moss-blue, tawny hide, raw-linen cream and very restrained bark-dark edging. No other objects or ornament. ABSOLUTELY NO trees, forest, river, water, antlers, horns, feathers, ring, circle, shield, plaque, scene, wreath, foliage, cord border, ribbon, arrowhead, text, letters, numbers, watermark, character, animal, weapon, skyline, mountain, polished jewel or decorative background. The crest itself is only the three unlike broad tracks meeting at the fork.
